== Biography ==
{{Ireland Native}}
William was born about 1837. <ref>Based on death 1924 age 87.</ref>
He was the son of Thomas Glasgow and lived in Killycurragh as of 1863.<ref name="m"/>

On 5 May 1863 at Claggan Presbyterian, he married Ellen McKinsey (or McKenzie) of Drumard, Lissan, daughter of John McKinsey, farmer.
<ref name="m">[https://civilrecords.irishgenealogy.ie/churchrecords/details-civil/8387e83323347 William Glasgow, Ellen McKinsey, 1863, Magherafelt] at Irish Civil Registration - Marriages</ref>

In 1892 he complained that some neighbours had threatened to shoot him.
<ref>[https://www.britishnewspaperarchive.co.uk/viewer/bl/0002006/18920213/061/0002 "District Notes"], ''Mid-Ulster Mail'' - Saturday 13 February 1892</ref>

In 1901 he was a widower living alone at Killycurragh still.

As of 1911 he was living at Clare, Kildress with his son Frederick.

In Dec 1914 he attended the funeral of brother [[Glasgow-1676|James]].

He passed away 11 May 1924 age 87 at Clare. He was interred at the Claggan Churchyard.
<ref>[https://www.britishnewspaperarchive.co.uk/viewer/bl/0002006/19240517/146/0008 "Obituary - William Glasgow, Clare"], ''Mid-Ulster Mail'' - Saturday 17 May 1924, Page 8</ref>
The chief mourners were:
* Henry Glasgow, Wm J Glasgow, Jas Fred Glasgow (sons)
* Robert Glasgow, Fred Glasgow, Silas Glasgow, Albert Glasgow (grandsons)
* Henry Glasgow, Walter Glasgow (nephews)
* Samuel Glasgow, John Glsagow, Isaac Bell (cousins)
* John Glasgow, Joseph McQueen (relatives)

== Research Notes ==
=== Individual father review, 22 October 2026 ===

This dated review supersedes any earlier grade of this pair within the stated record scope. The existing father [[Glasgow-1684]] is assessed at 98% (proved). William's 1863 marriage account names father Thomas and Killycurragh residence. His explicit brotherhood with James supplies a second, consistent family anchor for Thomas-1684.

Selected Glasgow-1684 fatherhood of Glasgow-1694; maternal identity and upstream ancestry are separate.

Next useful test: Compare original 1863 father column with James's 1857 marriage.
